Happy birthday, Saanvi 🤍

okay so I tried to write something deep and deleted it three times, because everything sounded like a greeting card. so this is just me, talking.

you're the person I text before I've even finished telling the story. you've seen me at my most unhinged, laughed (a lot), and somehow stayed. honestly? that's our whole friendship in one sentence 😭

I hope this year is soft on you. I hope the people you love keep showing up, and the things you've been quietly wishing for finally show up too. you deserve all of it, and I'll be clapping loudly from the front row. always.

thank you for being my person. for every "be honest, is this okay?", every dumb inside joke nobody else would ever get, and every time you made a bad day smaller.

happy birthday, my favourite human. I love you more than I say out loud 🫶

— Shrishti
